definitions.explanation: The physical location where building, road, or infrastructure construction is taking place.

examples.japanese: {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not enter the construction site.

examples.japanese: {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need a helmet when passing in front of the construction site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Loud noise from the nighttime construction site could be heard, and nearby residents filed complaints.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (construction work) and ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ (site, scene). A very common compound in daily life, as Japanese cities frequently have road and building construction. Signs reading ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ (under construction) are ubiquitous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ — to work at a construction site
- {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}→安全管理：23551_anzenkanri⟧ — construction site safety management
- {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ — no trespassing at the construction site
- {工事現場|こうじげんば}⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧ — area around the construction site

RELATED WORDS:
- {建設現場|けんせつげんば} — building construction site (similar but emphasizes building rather than civil works)
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ — under construction
- {現場監督|げんばかんとく} — site supervisor; foreman
